header.label: OpenAEC Ecosystem
header.title: Open Speech Studio
header.desc: Free local speech recognition with Whisper AI. Press CTRL+Win and dictate into any application - chat, email, terminal, IDE. No cloud, no subscription, no limits. v0.10.3 stable, 1 installer, ready in 30 seconds.
header.meta: v0.10.3 · 80 commits · Whisper AI · Tauri 2 · Rust

usecases.heading: Use cases for AEC professionals
usecases.intro: Whether you're inspecting on-site, taking minutes in a project meeting, or dictating an email between tasks - Open Speech Studio works everywhere, even offline.

inspection.title: On-site inspections
inspection.desc: Dictate findings directly into Open Field Studio while taking photos. No taking off gloves, no typing on a tiny screen. Just talk - done.

meetings.title: Meeting minutes
meetings.desc: Real-time transcription of project meetings on location. Fully processed locally - no privacy concerns about client names, prices, or confidential project data in the cloud.

email.title: Quick emails on-site
email.desc: Dictate into Outlook or Gmail between tasks. Hands-free when your hands are dirty, you're wearing safety gloves, or holding a ladder.

ai.title: Writing AI prompts
ai.desc: Dictate a prompt for Claude or ChatGPT much faster than typing. Speaking is ~3x faster and you often phrase more naturally - ideal for long, detailed prompts.

code.title: Code comments and commits
code.desc: Dictate code explanations, docstrings, and commit messages directly into your IDE or terminal. Works seamlessly in VS Code, Cursor, Neovim - anywhere you can enter text.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.desc: For RSI patients, people with motor impairments, or temporary injuries. Work your entire computer completely keyboard-free - GDPR-safe and subscription-free.

why.heading: Why local?
why.intro: Cloud speech recognition sends your voice to third-party servers. Open Speech Studio does everything on your own PC - faster, safer, and without monthly costs.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.desc: Your voice never leaves your computer. GDPR-safe automatically - no DPA needed with external providers, no risk of data breaches.

cost.title: No subscription
cost.desc: Otter.ai charges ~€20/month. Dragon NaturallySpeaking ~€500 one-time. Open Speech Studio is free forever - open source LGPL-3.0.

limits.title: No rate limits
limits.desc: Dictate 10 hours a day if you want. No API quotas, no 'Fair Use Policy', no surprise invoices. Your hardware is the only limit.

features.heading: Features - what can it do?
features.intro: Open Speech Studio is more than a dictation tool. It's a complete speech-to-text suite with audio file transcription, meeting recordings, multiple Whisper models, and export to standard subtitle formats.

dictate.title: Dictate anywhere
dictate.desc: Dictate text directly into any application via a system-wide overlay. Works in Outlook, Word, Chrome, VS Code, Slack, Teams - literally anywhere in your OS.

transcribe.title: Audio file transcription
transcribe.desc: Transcribe audio files (.mp3, .wav, .m4a, .ogg) with parallel processing. Multiple files at once, fast and accurate.

meetings.title: Real-time meeting transcription
meetings.desc: Record project meetings and watch the transcription appear in real time. Automatic minutes, even offline on the job site.

gpu.title: CUDA GPU acceleration
gpu.desc: CUDA GPU acceleration for faster results. On a modern GPU, Whisper Large runs nearly real-time - optimal use of your hardware.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: CTRL+Win for the overlay, CTRL+SHIFT+Space as alternative. No mouse click needed, no menu hunting - dictation starts in <100ms.

models.title: Whisper AI models
models.desc: 5 models: tiny, base, small, medium, large. Choose between speed (tiny) or accuracy (large). Memory usage 1-10GB depending on model.

languages.title: 99 languages
languages.desc: Whisper supports 99 languages: Dutch, English, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Arabic, Mandarin and many more. Automatic language detection.

overlay.title: Spotify-style overlay
overlay.desc: Sleek, minimalist overlay UI with live waveform visualization. Stays out of the way, disappears automatically after inserting.

history.title: History
history.desc: Full history of transcriptions - searchable, reusable. Everything stored locally, you stay in control.

export.title: Export TXT, SRT, VTT
export.desc: Export transcriptions as plain text (.txt) or as subtitles (.srt, .vtt) for video content with timestamps.

clipboard.title: Clipboard integration
clipboard.desc: Automatic clipboard integration - dictate and paste directly, or let text auto-insert at the cursor position.

local.title: 100% local
local.desc: Everything runs locally on your own computer. Your data never leaves your PC. No cloud, no subscription, no limits. GDPR-safe out of the box.

tech.title: Whisper AI + Tauri + Rust
tech.desc: Built with OpenAI Whisper AI for speech recognition, Tauri for the desktop app and Rust for the backend. Open source.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.desc: Start speech-to-text anywhere in your operating system:
shortcuts.note: Configurable in settings - choose your own shortcut if it conflicts with other software.

tech.heading: Tech stack
tech.desc: Open Speech Studio is built on a modern, performant stack. OpenAI Whisper for state-of-the-art speech recognition. Rust for a lightweight, fast backend (no Python runtime needed). Tauri 2 for the desktop app - much lighter than Electron (~10MB instead of 200MB). TypeScript + Svelte for the UI. Fully open source under LGPL-3.0.

finalcta.heading: Download now - 30 second setup
finalcta.desc: 1 installer file (.exe), no registration, no account, no credit card. Ready to dictate in <1 minute. Works on Windows 10 and Windows 11.
